highlights.label: Engine-free game logic
highlights.body: Every game's rules live in one module with zero Roblox API calls, so the entire logic layer runs under a plain Luau CLI. That is what makes a headless pipeline possible: the tests below run in CI in seconds, with no editor and no game client.

highlights.label: A written contract, not conventions
highlights.body: The portfolio has a single canonical engineering contract covering architecture invariants, the local CI mirror, and which operations require a human. Every repo points at it instead of restating it.

highlights.label: Publishing is a guarded operation
highlights.body: Pushing to main on a live game deploys to players, so agents and tooling branch and open a pull request; a human merges. The MCP server enforces the same rule server-side.

intro: The interesting part of this portfolio is not any single project — it is that one person can keep {games} games and a desktop app moving at once. That comes down to three decisions.
